purpose: Internal source of truth for planned, draft, active, deprecated, replaced, and archived NEWAX project domains and their integration with the Core NEWAX Database.

governance.important_note: A registry entry tracks a project domain. It does not approve that project for governed integration. Only a project with active status and a completed onboarding review may be treated as a conformant Core integration. A declared conformance_level is a claim until the conformance suite proves it.

integration_classes.A: Service with its own database. Full integration surface: SDK, replicated read models, outbox and inbox.
integration_classes.B: Offline-first client with a device-local store. SDK, sync cursor, and conflict policy. No server-side event consumer.
integration_classes.C: Stateless web property with no database. Measurement and tag integration plus read-only SDK calls.
integration_classes.D: External or third-party system outside NEWAX code control. Integrated through a core-owned adapter. Never holds a mirror.
integration_classes.E: Analytics or reporting consumer. Rollup store access only. No operational reads.

conformance_levels.L0: Registered. Holds a project_key and appears in the platform map.
conformance_levels.L1: Identity consumer. Resolves tenant, person, and user identity through Core.
conformance_levels.L2: Mirror consumer. Maintains core_mirror_* read models from Core events.
conformance_levels.L3: Master-data contributor. Submits candidate records to Core through a signed outbox.
conformance_levels.L4: Measured. Emits canonical Growth events and propagates consent.
conformance_levels.L5: Rolled up. Included in cross-project analytics.

projects.description: Discovers, qualifies, and allocates institutional leads, and contributes canonical institution and contact records to the Central Registry.
projects.compatibility_notes: Already ships a signed outbound envelope and a durable outbox in src/lead_harvester/integrations/lead_sync_emitter.py and src/lead_harvester/models/outbox.py. That producer predates the Core inbox and is the reference implementation the contract standard must reconcile with, not replace casually. Local person_candidates and canonical_institutions remain project-owned candidate staging and are not mirrors.

projects.description: Manages outbound conversations, message sequences, drafts, and consent across communication channels.
projects.compatibility_notes: Holds local consent, contact, and lead models that overlap the planned Core Growth domain. Convergence order is defined by the core convergence map, not by this entry.

projects.description: Commerce platform covering catalog, cart, orders, payments, measurements, stitching, and a customer relationship surface.
projects.compatibility_notes: Holds local User, RefreshToken, Address, AuditLog, and a CRM surface that overlap Core identity and Growth. Also ships an independent OutboxEvent implementation that the contract standard must reconcile alongside the harvester producer.

projects.description: Multi-platform client application with a device-local store and intermittent connectivity.
projects.compatibility_notes: Class B. The device store is not a server-side project database and must not be treated as one. It synchronises through a cursor with a declared conflict policy rather than consuming the Core delivery log. It has no server-side event consumer.
Class C. Holds no database. Integrates at L4 by registering a measurement container rather than by shipping integration code, which is the property that keeps web-property onboarding cheap.
Class C. Repository currently holds documentation only. Registered so that its integration path is defined before implementation begins rather than after.
